title: Haunted Wirral: A very close encounter
excerpt: WELCOME to Haunted Wirral, a feature series written by world-famous psychic researcher, Tom Slemen for the Globe.
content:
WELCOME to Haunted Wirral, a feature series written by world-famous psychic researcher, Tom Slemen for the Globe.

EARLY one autumn morning in September 2022, at around 5.40am, a joiner named Jeff from Higher Bebington had a blazing row with wife Sam and stormed out of the house.

He drove around aimlessly for a while, unsure of what to do, before finally deciding to call on an old friend named Peter, who lived in Heswall.

Jeff was not thinking about anything remotely paranormal. His mind was entirely occupied by an ordinary marital disagreement, and he kept going over what he should and should not have said to his wife. However, something utterly extraordinary was about to interrupt his journey.

He intended to drive along Barnston Road and turn right into Milner Road, but as he approached the junction, he saw that his route was blocked by signs reading ‘Road Closed’ and ‘Diversion’.

Far more astonishing, however, was the gigantic, metallic, almost spherical object hovering just above the hedgerows at the junction. It appeared to be some fifty feet in diameter and forty feet high.

At that moment, Jeff's car stalled, his radio went dead, and his iPhone buzzed briefly before its screen went blank in the dashboard-mounted holder.

Jeff tried to restart the car, but the engine refused to turn over. Taking his phone with him, he climbed out of the vehicle and gingerly walked around the corner into Milner Road.

The enormous craft looked utterly unearthly, particularly because it seemed to be leaning impossibly off balance on its edge.

As Jeff stared at it, the object began to undergo a bizarre transformation. Its metallic surface became semi-transparent, then solid again, before turning almost completely transparent, allowing him to see the field beyond it.

The strange process continued, as though the craft were repeatedly switching some form of invisibility device on and off.

Jeff tried his iPhone again, but the screen remained blank, even though the battery had been around seventy per cent charged when he left home.

Unable to summon help or even take a photograph of the extraordinary object, Jeff wondered what to do next. He decided to return to his car and attempt to push it farther along Barnston Road.

He suspected that some sort of invisible field surrounding the craft had disabled both the engine and his phone. Perhaps, he reasoned, if he could move the vehicle far enough away from the UFO, everything would start working again.

Just as Jeff was about to return to his car, the craft suddenly lit up.

Several windows became visible in its strange metallic hull, and at one of them, approximately twenty feet above the ground, Jeff could clearly see two female figures. Both had long brown hair and extraordinarily pale faces. The window was situated on the underside of the peculiar vehicle, which made the sight even more bewildering.

For a moment, Jeff wondered whether he had stumbled upon some elaborate reality television stunt, but he quickly dismissed the idea. What technology available in 2022 could disable a car engine and render a fully charged iPhone useless?

He was about to turn away when something even more extraordinary happened.

From the far side of Milner Road, a young woman appeared. She crossed the road near the diversion signs and walked directly towards Jeff, holding out her arms as though greeting someone she knew intimately.

She was the most beautiful woman Jeff had ever seen.

Standing approximately five feet five inches tall, she had long, perfectly straight platinum-blonde hair and a face as flawless as porcelain, although her complexion was extraordinarily pallid. Her eyes were almost almond-shaped and appeared to be green, accentuated by dark, winged eyeliner. Her lips were a striking fluorescent pink.

Jeff estimated her age to be somewhere between eighteen and twenty. She wore a close-fitting, one-piece garment, something we might describe as a catsuit or bodysuit, but the material was unlike anything Jeff had ever encountered.

It was continually changing colour.

Mesmerising, kaleidoscopic patterns flowed across the fabric, forming intricate geometric shapes that dissolved and reappeared in different colours.

Even more astonishingly, some of these luminous patterns seemed to detach themselves from the garment and float around the woman, resembling the three-dimensional holograms familiar from science-fiction films.

Jeff stood rooted to the spot, utterly dumbfounded and yet strangely beguiled by the beautiful, enigmatic stranger.

Interestingly, scientists today are developing fabrics capable of changing colour electronically, sometimes by incorporating incredibly fine conductive fibres into the material itself. Such technology includes electrochromic textiles, often referred to as e-textiles.

However, these developments remain largely experimental, and certainly in September 2022, clothing capable of producing the effects Jeff described would have been extraordinary.

The young woman's outfit continued to scintillate with changing colours as she approached him.

Then, without warning, she threw her arms around him.

Just before she embraced him, Jeff became aware of an extraordinarily potent, sweet-smelling perfume. It was unlike any fragrance he had ever encountered, and he struggled to identify anything familiar in its scent.

The young woman hugged him tightly and exclaimed, ‘Ah! Are you okay, Jeff?’ Despite the warmth of her embrace, Jeff felt a sudden chill run through him.

How on earth did she know his name? Who was she, and what was happening?

He tried to pull away, but the woman held him in an astonishingly powerful bear hug. For a moment, her grip was so tight that he could scarcely breathe.

‘Get off!’ Jeff shouted, pushing her away with considerable force.

The moment he did so, the dazzling colours and floating geometric patterns surrounding the woman abruptly vanished. Her remarkable outfit seemed to switch itself off, becoming a plain, featureless garment.

She stood motionless, staring at Jeff with an expression of profound shock, as though she could not understand his reaction.

Jeff turned and fled.

He ran down Barnston Road, convinced that the beautiful stranger was something sinister masquerading as a human being. Perhaps she had intended to lure him aboard the craft, where he might have been abducted and never seen again.

By the time he reached the corner of Beech Road, Jeff was breathing heavily and looking desperately for someone who might help him.

He spotted a woman posting a letter into a pillar box. ‘Excuse me!’ he called.

The woman turned, but her expression immediately became wary. It was still a cold, dark autumn morning, and a breathless stranger approaching her in the street was understandably a cause for concern.

Jeff noticed her taking a mobile phone from her coat pocket, so he remained where he was, keeping a respectful distance.

‘Something very strange has just happened to me!’ he said.

The woman narrowed her eyes. ‘What?’ Jeff told her that a UFO had appeared at the junction of Barnston Road and Milner Road, and that both his car and mobile phone had inexplicably stopped working.

Then, conscious of how incredible his account sounded, he added, ‘I'm not crazy or on drugs. I swear I'm telling the truth.’ The woman, whose name was Gemma, studied him for a moment. Something about his manner apparently convinced her that he was genuinely frightened rather than attempting to deceive her.

She agreed to accompany him back towards Milner Road.

As they walked up Barnston Road, Jeff deliberately kept his distance from Gemma, not wishing to make her feel threatened.

When they were approximately two hundred feet from the junction with Milner Road, both suddenly saw something that stopped them in their tracks.

The enormous craft was rising silently into the sky.

Its lights were now extinguished, and it appeared as a dark grey, elliptical shape against the early morning sky. It climbed steadily without making the slightest sound.

‘Oh!’ gasped Gemma.

She stood beside Jeff, staring in astonishment as the mysterious object continued its silent ascent until it was finally lost to sight.

Neither uttered a word for several moments. Then both jumped as a sudden bright light appeared farther down the road.

It was Jeff's car.

The headlamps had inexplicably switched themselves on, and as Jeff hurried towards the vehicle, he could hear the radio playing. His iPhone was working again, too. As he approached the car, several notification tones sounded from the phone. He discovered that his wife had sent him a succession of text messages, presumably wondering where he had gone after their argument. Jeff was completely bewildered.

He told Gemma that, during the encounter, he had genuinely wondered whether he was losing his mind. He had never taken recreational drugs in his life and rarely touched alcohol. He could think of no rational explanation for what he had witnessed.

Gemma, however, had seen the enormous object rising into the sky with her own eyes, and she assured Jeff that he had not imagined that part of the experience.

Together, they examined the area where the mysterious craft had been hovering.

There were no scorch marks, flattened patches of grass or other obvious signs that anything extraordinary had occurred. However, they did notice that a small tree near the hedgerow had been bent out of shape, almost as though an enormous weight had pressed against it.

Whether this damage had anything to do with the craft was impossible to determine.

Gemma subsequently invited Jeff to her home on Pine Road, where he was able to recover from his ordeal and discuss what had happened. The two became friends following that extraordinary morning.

When Jeff later related the incident to me, he asked whether I thought the beautiful blonde woman who had embraced him was an extraterrestrial. I was at a loss to answer.

One possibility, I suggested, was that the woman had been some sophisticated illusion, perhaps projected by an intelligence aboard the craft. Could her extraordinary beauty and apparent affection have been deliberately calculated to entice Jeff into entering the UFO? Was the embrace an attempt to gain his confidence, or had the woman genuinely mistaken him for someone else?

There was, however, another possibility that intrigued me even more.

What if the mysterious craft had not originated on another planet at all? What if it had come from another time?

Perhaps the object was some form of time machine, and the beautiful young woman was not an extraterrestrial but a human being from the distant future, someone who, in September 2022, had probably not even been born.

Her extraordinary clothing, with its shifting colours and floating holographic patterns, might then have been an example of technology that humanity has yet to develop.

And what of her apparent knowledge of Jeff's name?

Had she somehow recognised him, or was she equipped with a device capable of detecting his thoughts and translating them into information? Could some form of electronic telepathy have allowed her to learn his identity before she approached him? We could speculate endlessly.

Of course, there is no evidence that the craft was a time machine, any more than there is proof that it came from another world. Nevertheless, Jeff's account raises some fascinating questions.

There were several reports of unusual aerial phenomena in that part of Wirral around the same period, and Gemma remained adamant that the strange object she had watched ascending silently into the sky was unlike anything she had ever seen. She believed it was not of this world.

As for Jeff, he had set out that autumn morning with nothing more extraordinary on his mind than an argument with his wife.

Within a short time, he had encountered a gigantic, apparently invisible spacecraft, witnessed two mysterious figures looking down at him from its windows, and been embraced by a beautiful stranger who somehow knew his name.

Whatever the explanation, it was certainly a morning he would never forget.
